correctness.rationale: Exact spectral projector reconstruction gives the two diagonal rational polynomials. All off-diagonal entries are positive by strict decrease of (z+6)/(z^2+4z+6). At q<=9 exact Sturm root counts show both diagonal quartics positive. At q>=10 negative rational witnesses and Descartes rule imply exactly two simple roots of each. The Sylvester resultant has only one positive size-parameter zero between 30 and 31, and signs at q=10 and q=31 determine the root ordering on each side. The extracted checker passed 281 exact assertions, including finite full-matrix identities.

value.rationale: Provides a sharp and complete all-step nonnegativity design rule for a natural connected simple graph family of minimum degree two. The intermediate positivity band between two negativity windows is genuinely lost as graph size crosses from 30 to 31 on the large side, a qualitative phenomenon not implied by unconditional-positivity thresholds; the exact algebraic boundaries are directly computable.
